metrics.label: 安全有效关闭率
metrics.numerator: Cases with a structured closure_assessment in state closed
metrics.denominator: Cases closed in the reporting window
metrics.drilldown: closed cases missing or holding a structured safe closure assessment

metrics.label: 首次联系解决率
metrics.numerator: Safely closed Cases with no reopen and no second linked Conversation
metrics.denominator: Safely closed Cases in the reporting window
metrics.drilldown: safely closed cases with reopen or repeated conversation

metrics.label: 72 小时重开率
metrics.numerator: Cases with a structured reopened assessment within 72 hours of structured closure
metrics.denominator: Cases with a structured closure assessment

metrics.label: 7 天重开率
metrics.numerator: Cases with a structured reopened assessment within 7 days of structured closure
metrics.denominator: Cases with a structured closure assessment

metrics.label: 重复联系率
metrics.numerator: Closed Cases with reopen_count greater than zero or more than one linked Conversation
metrics.denominator: Closed Cases in the reporting window

metrics.label: 人工接管接受率
metrics.numerator: Handoff requests accepted in the reporting window
metrics.denominator: Handoff requests created in the reporting window

metrics.label: 人工接管等待 P50
metrics.numerator: Median seconds from handoff requested_at to accepted_at
metrics.drilldown: handoff requests above the current median

metrics.label: 每个关闭案例人工触达
metrics.numerator: External comments plus internal notes authored by users for closed Cases
metrics.denominator: Closed Cases in the reporting window
metrics.drilldown: closed cases with high human-touch count

metrics.label: 业务动作完成率
metrics.numerator: Structured execution attempts or operational outcomes in a successful/confirmed state
metrics.denominator: Terminal structured execution attempts and operational outcomes

metrics.label: 客户通知合规率
metrics.numerator: Structured customer notifications delivered, confirmed or explicitly waived

metrics.label: Provider 失败率
metrics.numerator: Structured provider receipts in failed or repair-required state

metrics.label: AI 有质量自助解决率
metrics.numerator: Completed public AI turns whose Conversation has no accepted handoff and whose linked Case has no reopen
metrics.denominator: Completed or failed public AI turns in the reporting window
metrics.drilldown: AI turns followed by handoff, failure or reopen

metrics.label: 每个解决案例成本
metrics.numerator: Approved labor, Provider, telephony and infrastructure cost facts
metrics.drilldown: unavailable until an approved cost ledger is configured
